description: An 80 x 80 x 40 block with a 60 x 60 pocket cut 15 deep from the top with a -10 deg taper (its floor 54.7 mm across at z 25), its rim and its four slanted corner edges filleted R3, then the pocket's floor extruded 5 mm further down as a cut, so the pocket goes on without a step. The floor's corners are the elliptic arcs where the corner rounds meet it, fitted in the profile: the cut's boolean failed on them, and its retry nudged the tool and kept the old floor at z 25 as a skin over a sealed void, so the pocket looked as deep as before. Result: one shell, the floor at z 20, the floor's area times 5 mm taken.
